description:
Welcome to NOVERA! We are a dedicated team participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, focused on creating innovative solutions for modern agricultural and space-farming challenges.
Our mission is to leverage Earth observation data, satellite technology, and AI to build scalable, sustainable solutions for food security on Earth and future space missions.
Why Join NOVERA?
We offer an ambitious, collaborative environment where creative ideas turn into impactful prototypes.
summary:
English summary ready to paste:

Terra Space is a bilingual, voice-first agricultural assistant that turns NASA Earth observations into practical field decisions for smallholder farmers. Farmers select a crop and location to receive heat and drought alerts, irrigation guidance, and crop-health support in Arabic or English. The platform combines NASA POWER, SMAP, GPM IMERG, MODIS/VIIRS NDVI, and Landsat data with a crop-stage model, then explains recommended actions in plain language. Photo-based triage and human-engineer escalation close the last-mile gap between open space data and the farmer who needs

to act on it.
